title: Relationship Type Vocabulary
description: Controlled semantic metadata for explicit Contract Registry relationship types and graph-only derived associations.

types.label: Implements
types.description: Source declares conformance to or implementation of the target standard/contract.

types.label: References
types.description: Source refers to the target without embedding its full value model.

types.label: Governs
types.description: Source defines rules or policy that govern the target.

types.label: Belongs to
types.description: Source belongs to the target parent, owner or module.

types.label: Depends on
types.description: Source depends on the target according to the source contract.

types.label: Composes
types.description: Source composes one required target contract or structure.

types.label: Related to
types.description: Source declares a meaningful non-hierarchical association with the target.

types.label: Uses contract
types.description: Source capability or definition consumes the target canonical contract.

types.label: Applies to
types.description: Source rule, policy or definition applies to the target.

types.label: Uses
types.description: Source uses the target as part of its defined operation or discovery behavior.

types.label: Optionally composes
types.description: Source may compose one target contract when the feature/data is present.

types.label: Optionally references
types.description: Source may refer to the target when applicable.

types.label: Aligns with
types.description: Source intentionally aligns behavior or vocabulary with the target.

types.label: Composes many
types.description: Source composes a collection of target contract values.

types.label: Required dependency
types.description: Target must be present/enabled for the source to operate as defined.

types.label: Optionally composes many
types.description: Source may compose zero or more target values.

types.label: Contains
types.description: Source contains or groups the target as a child/member.

types.label: Recommended dependency
types.description: Target is recommended for a complete source implementation but is not strictly required.

types.label: Mirrors
types.description: Source intentionally mirrors selected semantics or structure of the target.

types.label: Self references
types.description: Source may reference another instance of its own canonical type, usually for hierarchy.

types.label: Generated from
types.description: Source is deterministically generated or projected from the target.

types.label: Conditional dependency
types.description: Target is required only when a documented condition/capability is enabled.

types.label: Optional dependency
types.description: Target can extend the source but is not required for the base behavior.

types.label: Documents
types.description: Source documentation explicitly documents the target definition.

types.label: Associated permission
types.description: Graph-only association derived from the source registry item permissions array.

types.label: Associated Event
types.description: Graph-only association derived from the source registry item events array when the Event resolves to a Registry node.
